obligations.source_text: Her clothed upper torso is visibly broader than her hips, with a full bust and strong shoulder line flowing into a sharply indented narrow waist before the silhouette opens modestly toward slightly narrower hips.

bindings.adult_bilateral_view_phrase: both outer torso contours remain visible from shoulders through the natural waist to the hips in a restrained three-quarter bilateral silhouette
bindings.narrow_waist_phrase: a comparatively narrower natural waist with a bilateral inward waist transition
bindings.two_sided_expansion_phrase: the upper torso and hips both expand away from the waist
bindings.upper_dominance_phrase: the upper expansion visibly exceeds lower expansion, owned by the natural shoulder, ribcage, and bust contour
